title: fix(agent builder): sub agent execution failing after graph/step updates
body:
## Summary

Fixes `run_subagent` (and persistent sub-agents via `send_message`, and background ones) failing since #292185 with:

```
Sub-agent execution failed: Error executing standalone agent: No response event found in round events
```
